schemaConflict.conflict: Both define outcome_ledger with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS but different columns and lifecycle semantics.
schemaConflict.safeDisposition: Do not rerun either definition and do not alter the live table until an additive migration is designed against the live schema.

directColumns.taskId: task_id, only when the receipt taskId is a valid UUID
directColumns.traceId: trace_id, only when the receipt run/correlation value is a valid UUID
directColumns.toolCallId: tool_call_id, only when the value is a valid UUID
directColumns.status: outcome_type or metadata.status; outcome_type is not a safe lifecycle-status column

receiptIdentityGap: receiptId has no dedicated live column
runId has no dedicated live column
openspecChange and openspecTaskIds have no dedicated live columns
agent/model identity and timing/token fields have no dedicated live columns
receiptFieldMapping.uuidSafety: Do not cast arbitrary receiptId, runId, taskId, or tool references to uuid. Preserve non-UUID identifiers in metadata until an explicit identity mapping exists.

writerGaps: recordOutcome currently accepts arbitrary metadata and suppresses database errors
No typed AgentWorkReceiptV1 to Postgres adapter exists
No durable acknowledgement/readback is returned to the workflow RECORD stage
No receiptId/runId idempotency constraint or replay proof exists
NDJSON and Postgres outcome lanes are not yet projected from one acknowledged canonical write

typedWriter.replay: same receipt_id and checksum returns existing ledger id
typedWriter.conflict: same receipt_id with different checksum fails closed

boundedWorkflowMigration.reason: The workflow is a standalone .mjs CLI and the acknowledged writer is server-side TypeScript; direct import would create a second boundary or require a launcher contract change.
boundedWorkflowMigration.currentBehavior: The RECORD stage still appends the diagnostic NDJSON ledger.
safeOptions: Expose an explicit local/server receipt endpoint and call it from the CLI
Run the CLI through the approved TypeScript runtime with an explicit module contract
Move the workflow RECORD stage into the existing server owner
boundedWorkflowMigration.prohibitedShortcut: Do not duplicate Postgres receipt SQL in the .mjs workflow.
boundedWorkflowMigration.workflowBehavior: The recommendation RECORD stage now calls the endpoint, requires acknowledgement, then appends diagnostic NDJSON. Endpoint-unavailable behavior is fail-closed.

liveProof.replayPolicy: A replay emits RECEIPT_REPLAY with canonicalMutation=false; it is not a second completed-work event.

additiveMigrationDesign.newIndex: UNIQUE partial index on receipt_id WHERE receipt_id IS NOT NULL
additiveMigrationDesign.idempotencyBehavior: Same receipt_id must return the existing durable row without creating a second row; conflicting receipt content must fail closed with a checksum mismatch.
additiveMigrationDesign.acknowledgementBehavior: The canonical insert must use INSERT ... RETURNING id, receipt_id, completion_checksum; swallowed database errors are not acknowledgement.
additiveMigrationDesign.migrationGuard: Add nullable columns and the partial unique index only; do not backfill, rename, drop, or reinterpret existing rows.

recommendedAdditiveSequence: Define an explicit Postgres adapter payload for AgentWorkReceiptV1
Choose whether receiptId and runId get dedicated nullable columns or remain in metadata
Add a unique/idempotency key only after its identity type and conflict behavior are proven
Write Postgres first and require INSERT/RETURNING acknowledgement
Project the acknowledged row to diagnostic NDJSON only after success
Read back by receipt identity and replay the same receipt with zero duplicate durable rows
blockedUntil: Live schema migration design is reviewed against the actual 10-column table
Receipt identity mapping and UUID policy are explicit
Idempotent write plus independent readback test exists
